addons.effect: While healing yourself or another Survivor, Secondary Action grants +5% Movement speed for 16 seconds and creates a Blight trail behind the affected Survivor. Consumes the Med-Kit when triggered.
addons.notes: Halloween Event add-on. The project-facing rarity bucket remains Event with gold presentation; underlying game rarity is Common under the 9.0.0 Event-unlockable reassignment, with 9.2.2's Halloween rarity exception applying to Items/Offering rather than add-ons. The generic unavailable-content boilerplate says stockpiles cannot be used, but the entity-specific description explicitly overrides it: STOCKPILES MAY STILL BE USED IN TRIALS. The current entity page further states accumulated stockpiles may be used in regular ranked Trials throughout the year and are always available in Custom Game. At the 2026-10-12 cutoff it was not acquirable because it is only available during Halloween Events and Haunted by Daylight 2026 begins 2026-10-13. Status event-stockpile-usable is therefore retained without treating October 13 activation as evidence for October 12 ordinary-Trial usability.
